metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the line sent by Heminges's man, the second Caesar as a morning title, and the Rose's last day.

yesterday: John Heminges's man took the sixty shillings and the line to the Bell. The line said you are well, and named Susanna, Hamnet, and Judith.
The morning title was the second Caesar. At the day's end it was their last, and the hampers were packing.
Kemp says they have run. John says Bankside has nowhere else of an afternoon. Margery would as soon they had somewhere. The padlocks are a rumour.
You wrote that the Rose's day was its last.
